name: Generate creative names for game systems and assets
description: Users asked to generate creative names, titles, keywords, or conceptual terms for specific in-game systems, mechanics, entities, and user-generated content. The requests frequently targeted functional game components like items, levels, and currencies, as well as broader creative assets such as team names, playlists, and game remasters.
